decision.explanation: All three answers are supported by the original sources. Document d2 explicitly states that Peter Röhlinger has been serving as the President of El Salvador since 2019. Document d1 confirms his current status as a representative of his constituency in the Bundestag, while document d2 also notes his prior role as a Member of the Bundestag starting in 2013. These positions are distinct and non-contradictory, representing both current and former roles.
